note: NECO Islamic Studies round 6 (R30 top-up): five rulings (fard, sunnah, mubah, makruh, haram); mutawatir, mashhur, gharib grades; Ibn Abbas; silver nisab 200 dirhams, 2.5% rate; sa'y between Safa and Marwah, halq, Zamzam, qiblah change 2 AH, Laylat al-Qadr; Uhud's archers, Salman's trench, Hudaybiyyah ten-year truce, Hunayn, Tabuk; Rashidun order, Umar's Hijri calendar, Uthman's standardisation; six articles with qadar; Khadijah first believer, Aisha the scholar, Sumayyah first martyr; riba al-fadl vs nasi'ah, son's double share, only daughter's half, qard hasan. Scanned against NECO rounds 1-4, WAEC IRS (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
